termsPageDescription: Rules for using 42Share as a 42 student community platform.
termsSection1Body: By signing in with your 42 Intra account or otherwise using 42Share, you agree to these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not use the platform.
termsSection2Body: 42Share is intended for members of the 42 network. You must authenticate through 42 OAuth. You are responsible for activity under your account and for keeping your session secure on shared devices.
termsSection3Body: You retain ownership of projects, posts, comments, events, and other material you submit. By publishing content, you grant 42Share a non-exclusive license to host, display, and distribute it on the platform so other students can view and interact with it.
termsSection4Body: Do not upload unlawful, harassing, or malicious content. Do not attempt to access other users' private data, disrupt the service, or misuse the public API. Repository links must point to public source code you are allowed to share.
termsSection5Body: We may suspend or remove accounts that violate these terms or harm the community. We may update these terms; continued use after changes are posted constitutes acceptance. Material changes will be reflected on this page.
termsSection6Body: 42Share is provided as-is for educational and community purposes. We do not guarantee uninterrupted availability. To the extent permitted by law, the platform operators are not liable for user-generated content or indirect damages arising from use of the service.
privacyPolicyPageDescription: How 42Share collects, uses, and protects personal data.
privacyPolicySection1Body: 42Share is a social platform for 42 students. This policy explains what personal data we process, why we process it, and what choices you have. It complements the GDPR tools available in your account settings.
privacyPolicySection2Body: When you sign in with 42 Intra we receive profile information from the 42 API (login, name, email, campus, avatar, and related Intra fields). We also store content you create—projects, screenshots, archives, posts, comments, events, connections, grades, and session tokens needed to keep you logged in.
privacyPolicySection3Body: We use your data to operate the platform: authenticate you, display profiles and feeds, enable search, host uploaded files, send GDPR confirmation emails, and maintain security logs. We do not sell your personal data.
privacyPolicySection4Body: We keep account data while your account is active. Session and refresh tokens expire according to configured TTLs. You may request export, anonymization, or deletion at any time from Privacy & data settings; deletion removes associated records across connected services.
privacyPolicySection5Body: Data is processed by our microservices (authentication, user profile, projects, comments) and stored in databases and object storage (e.g. MinIO/S3-compatible storage for uploads). Infrastructure runs in environments controlled by the project operators. Third-party 42 Intra is used solely for authentication and profile sync.
privacyPolicySection6Body: Depending on applicable law (including GDPR), you may access, export, rectify, restrict, or erase your data, or object to certain processing. Use the Privacy & data page to download a JSON export, request anonymization, or delete your account via email confirmation.
privacyPolicySection7Body: We use HttpOnly cookies for access and refresh tokens to maintain your session. Optional appearance and language preferences are stored locally in your browser. For privacy questions, contact the project maintainers listed in the repository documentation.
